turns.content: 华东地区上月销售额是多少

turns.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(paid_amount), 0) AS sales_amount FROM orders WHERE region = '华东';

turns.content: 各客户等级订单数分别是多少
各客户等级订单数分别为：战略客户186单，重点客户139单，普通客户275单。
turns.sql: SELECT c.customer_level AS "客户等级", COUNT(o.customer_id) AS "订单数" FROM customers AS c LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_level ORDER BY CASE c.customer_level WHEN '战略客户' THEN 1 WHEN '重点客户' THEN 2 WHEN '普通客户' THEN 3 END;
turns.answer: 各客户等级订单数分别为：战略客户186单，重点客户139单，普通客户275单。
